rules.never_set_state_by_hand: Run ./scripts/verify-feature.sh <ID>; that is the only supported transition to 'passing'.

status_legend.not_started: No recorded evidence yet. May still work — treat it as unverified.
status_legend.active: The one feature currently being worked on (WIP=1).
status_legend.blocked: Cannot proceed until the blocker in 'notes' is resolved.
status_legend.passing: The declared layers ran and the evidence string below records when.

features.title: Email sign-in, refresh and session gate
features.user_visible_behavior: A registered user signs in, lands in /app, and stays signed in across reloads; an expired access token is refreshed instead of bouncing to sign-in.

verification.label: auth router + security unit tests
verification.cmd: cd backend && uv run pytest tests/test_jwt_library.py tests/test_refresh_revocation.py -q
verification.repair: If a JWT or refresh test fails, check core/security.py (PyJWT, HS256 only) before touching api/v1/auth.py.

verification.label: frontend auth helper tests
verification.cmd: cd frontend && node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run src/test/lib/auth.test.ts src/test/lib/proxy.test.ts
verification.repair: lib/auth.ts is the only reader of the session cookie on the client; fix it there, not in components.

evidence: Live browser sign-in to /app verified 2026-10-28; session refresh exercised during that run.

features.title: Password reset and auth rate limiting
features.user_visible_behavior: Forgot-password always returns the same response shape, and repeated attempts are throttled rather than fail-open.

verification.label: rate limiter tests (includes the in-process fallback)
verification.cmd: cd backend && uv run pytest tests/test_rate_limit.py -q
verification.repair: If the fallback window test fails, check the in_process_window branch in core/rate_limit.py — the limiter must degrade to a local window, never to 'allow'.

evidence: tests/test_rate_limit.py green; live forgot-password returned 429 with fallback: in_process_window on 2026-10-28.
features.notes: The Upstash path is fail-open by design when the network is unreachable; the local window is what protects auth now.

features.title: Send a message and stream the answer
features.user_visible_behavior: A user submits a message, sees the reply stream token by token, and the finished turn is persisted.

verification.label: SSE translation tests (backend dialect -> AI SDK dialect)
verification.cmd: cd frontend && node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run src/test/chat-stream-translation.test.ts
verification.repair: A new backend event needs a translator branch in src/app/api/chat/route.ts; an untranslated event looks exactly like one never emitted.

verification.label: custom-event SSE trap tests
verification.cmd: cd backend && uv run pytest tests/test_stream_custom_event_trap.py -q
verification.repair: Check that the stream generator yields the custom event frames as dicts, not strings — a type mismatch silently drops frames.

evidence: Live browser run in Web mode returned a streamed, persisted answer on 2026-10-28.

features.title: Edit, delete and regenerate a message
features.user_visible_behavior: Editing a user message truncates and re-runs from that point; deleting removes it from the transcript; regenerate replaces the last answer.

verification.label: edit/delete/regenerate backend tests
verification.cmd: cd backend && uv run pytest tests/test_message_edit_delete.py -q
verification.repair: Edit and delete must invalidate the LangGraph checkpoint for that thread; without it the model still sees the removed text on the next turn.

features.notes: Known open defect carried from the last live investigation: graph checkpoints accumulate across turns, so a stale message can survive an edit/delete. Not reproduced after the truncation fix; keep this feature active if it reappears.

features.title: Rejoin an in-flight run and recover history
features.user_visible_behavior: Reloading mid-run reattaches to the running answer instead of duplicating or losing it.

verification.label: backend rejoin tests
verification.cmd: cd backend && uv run pytest tests/test_run_rejoin.py -q
verification.repair: Rejoin is a read of agent_runs/run_events, not a resend. If a run cannot be replayed, check that its events were written with increasing seq.

verification.label: frontend rejoin tests
verification.cmd: cd frontend && node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run src/test/hooks/chat-rejoin.test.ts src/test/chat-stream-rejoin.test.ts
verification.repair: useNexusChat.ts is the only writer to the transcript; a second writer is what produced duplicated messages before.

evidence: Both suites green; revert harness backend/revert_c3.py and frontend/revert_c3.py report every fix load-bearing.

features.title: Web mode answers from the research it gathered
features.user_visible_behavior: With Web enabled, a live question is answered from the gathered findings with a source, and the answer never claims it cannot access the web while findings are present.

verification.label: synthesis guard + research budget tests
verification.cmd: cd backend && uv run pytest tests/test_batch_c_correctness.py tests/test_batch_d_research.py -q
verification.repair: Four independent guards must all hold: evidence-adjacent directive, one bounded re-ask, refusal detector, and the deterministic fallback to the researcher's own synthesis.

evidence: Live browser re-test 2026-10-28 returned a sourced Reuters answer after the guard chain fired; all four reverts were load-bearing.
features.notes: Groq 403s datacenter VPN exit IPs, so on a VPN the router falls back to gemini flash-lite and the guards do more work than they should. Test without the VPN before concluding a regression.

features.title: Knowledge retrieval with HyDE and citations
features.user_visible_behavior: A question over imported documents returns an answer grounded in retrieved chunks, with citations the user can inspect.

verification.label: HyDE generation tests
verification.cmd: cd backend && uv run pytest tests/test_hyde_generation.py -q
verification.repair: HyDE must call ai_client.completion() (never complete() or the raw router) or the spend meter never sees it.

verification.label: citation payload tests
verification.cmd: cd backend && uv run pytest tests/test_run_citations.py -q
verification.repair: citation_payloads() is the single source for both the SSE frame and the message row; two sources will drift.

features.notes: Live quality caveat observed earlier: retrieval scored 0.99 for the right chunk and the model still declined to quote it — a synthesis-prompt issue, not a retrieval issue.

features.title: File upload, indexing and attachment to a turn
features.user_visible_behavior: A user uploads a document, sees it indexed, and can ask questions about it in the same conversation.

verification.label: upload + ingestion tests
verification.cmd: cd backend && uv run pytest tests/test_rag_ingest_pipeline.py tests/test_multimodal_persist.py -q
verification.repair: Indexing is inline on the upload request; if a document never becomes searchable, read POST /files/upload's response first — a 201 means ingestion ran, so the fault is in chunking/embedding, not in a missing worker.

verification.label: browser journey: upload, list, search, delete, backend-down
verification.cmd: cd frontend && npx playwright test e2e/files.spec.ts
verification.repair: Needs Docker, the backend on :8000 and the Next dev server. A connection-refused run is an environment failure, not a product one — run ./init.sh first.

evidence: scripts/verify-feature.sh passed all layers on 2026-10-29 at 8756a4c
features.notes: e2e/files.spec.ts already covers 5 journeys; only the browser layer is outstanding as evidence.

features.title: Render + Vercel free-tier deployment
features.user_visible_behavior: The backend answers /health and the frontend signs a user in against the deployed origins.

verification.label: deploy target docs are consistent
verification.cmd: cd backend && uv run pytest tests/test_db_target_guard.py tests/test_migration_graph.py -q
verification.repair: The three DSNs (env example, config default, compose service) must agree; the migration graph must have exactly one head.

verification.label: deploy preflight (everything provable without an account)
verification.cmd: bash scripts/deploy-preflight.sh --static
verification.repair: A failure names the file to fix: render.yaml must parse with a free-tier `nexus-backend` web service (no worker — Render free has none), the frontend must have a build script, and the deployment guide must document APP_PUBLIC_URL and /mcp/mcp. `tests/test_deploy_preflight.py` keeps the check load-bearing.

verification.label: full preflight incl. env names and credentials (run where the values exist)
verification.cmd: bash scripts/deploy-preflight.sh --env-file backend/.env.production
verification.repair: Prints variable NAMES and lengths only, never values. Each [FAIL] line is one value to supply: SECRET_KEY, ENCRYPTION_KEY, https DATABASE_URL, CORS_ORIGINS, https APP_PUBLIC_URL, plus a vercel CLI/VERCEL_TOKEN and render CLI/RENDER_API_KEY.

evidence: scripts/deploy-preflight.sh --static passed 2026-10-29: render.yaml parses (2 free web services), frontend build script present, APP_PUBLIC_URL and /mcp/mcp documented.
features.notes: Blocked on credentials only: no vercel/render CLI or tokens on this machine, and APP_PUBLIC_URL, CORS_ORIGINS, SECRET_KEY, ENCRYPTION_KEY and the production DATABASE_URL still need to be set. The one-command path is `bash scripts/deploy-preflight.sh` then apply render.yaml on Render and create the Vercel project for frontend/.
